title: LibreSSL: The first 30 days, and what the Future Holds
summary: Bob Beck of OpenBSD gives a BSDCan 2014 talk on the first month of LibreSSL, the OpenSSL fork. He explains why they forked, what they removed, and examples of the problems found in the OpenSSL code base.
why: Recommended as a funny, fascinating tour of how bad the OpenSSL code was and what cleanup looks like.

quote.text: There is a fascinating and funny talk by Bob Beck from OpenBSD on the first 30 days after forking OpenSSL.
